# Oxford Exchange

> Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Breakfast, lunch and tea in a restored 1891 building, with a bookstore, a shop and a glass-roofed courtyard under one roof.

- Phone: (813) 253-0222
- Address: 420 W Kennedy Blvd, Tampa, FL 33606
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Brunch and all day; Tea and coffee; The Champagne Bar
- Rating: 4.6 from 7038 Google reviews
